referenceSources.title: Toyota | Les sportives Toyota à travers l'histoire | COROLLA
referenceSources.description:
A white Toyota Corolla GTi hatchback stands prominently in a museum-like setting, flanked by earlier Corolla models and rally references. The GT-i 16 badge on its side, sporty front bumper, side skirts, and alloy wheels underscore its performance pedigree. In the background, a Corolla AE86 Levin and signage reading “Oudtshoorn” and “Aarlanderveen” evoke the model’s rally and drift history.

The exhibit is part of Toyota France’s heritage showcase, which traces the Corolla’s transformation from a best-selling compact to a bona fide sports car. Detailed metadata describes the AE86’s rear-wheel-drive layout and twin-cam engine, as well as the GTi’s 1.6L 130 hp powerplant, enhanced suspension, ventilated brakes, and aerodynamic enhancements that defined 1980s hot hatches.
